name: Education Observer Program (formerly Job Shadow Program)
what_you_do: Follow a health care worker at Denver Health to see a normal workday. You learn the skills and school needed for that job.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 or older in high school or an undergraduate college program. Under 18 needs permission from a parent or guardian. You must plan a health care career.
duration: Up to 40 hours within 2 months of approval
deadline_text: Winter and spring window: Nov 2, 2026 to Feb 1, 2027. Apply at least 4 weeks before you want to start. Summer window: Apr 2 to Jun 18, 2027.
how_to_apply: Find a Denver Health provider who will host you. Make an online profile. Upload the signed Observer and Confidentiality Agreement and your shot records all at once. Apply at least 4 weeks before you start.
notes: Denver Health does not assign providers, and a spot is not promised. One experience per year. Operating room and emergency department visits need age 18. Denver Health is at 777 Bannock Street, Denver. Sophomores can also look at the VISTA internship (formerly MC2).
